Zero Vanity Claims
Diagnostic Reality

Growth rarely breaks
in just one place.

Most marketing initiatives fail not because traffic is expensive, but because the path between discovery, conversion, and retention is completely fragmented.

Traffic Without Conversion

Spending aggressively on ad clicks that land on slow, cluttered pages with unclear value propositions and high drop-off rates.

Ads With Weak Tracking

Running campaigns without accurate server-side event deduplication, missing GA4 conversion funnels, and flying blind on true channel contribution.

Good Product, Poor UX

High product appeal sabotaged by friction-heavy checkout, poor mobile responsiveness, and lack of customer reassurance cues.

Visibility Without Journey

Organic rankings or social views that attract casual visitors but fail to guide them into dedicated consideration and purchase pathways.

Leads With Weak Follow-Up

Allowing high-intent prospect inquiries or abandoned carts to decay without automated nurturing, WhatsApp workflows, or structured retargeting.

Data Without Action

Collecting gigabytes of analytics without a unified feedback mechanism to systematically optimize landing pages and ad creative.

The Groniq Thesis
Groniq looks at the complete system, not just the channel.

Methodology

From Diagnosis
To Growth.

A systematic 6-phase framework to identify bottlenecks, implement fixes, and drive compounding digital performance.

01 Discovery

AUDIT

Deep dive into your existing business model, target audience, traffic sources, conversion metrics, and technical setup.

02 Analysis

DIAGNOSE

Identify the exact points of leakage: ad targeting inefficiencies, website friction, broken tracking, or missing follow-up systems.

03 Roadmap

STRATEGY

Define a prioritized growth roadmap detailing which marketing channels, website enhancements, and systems will yield the highest impact.

04 Execution

BUILD

Implement the required marketing campaigns, high-converting landing pages, e-commerce storefronts, and tracking infrastructure.

05 Analytics

MEASURE

Track meaningful business outcomes, customer acquisition costs, conversion velocities, and clean event data through GA4 and GTM.

06 Compounding

OPTIMIZE

Use data-driven experiments, A/B testing, and funnel refinement to progressively lower acquisition costs and elevate conversion rates.
